name: Mohsin Naqvi
quote: "The long march has already begun, and we will not spare anyone who violates the law."

name: Sohail Afridi
quote: Said PTI's sole purpose was a peaceful rally demanding Imran Khan's release (paraphrased, AP).

name: Attaullah Tarar
quote: Said PTI has a track record of disruption and vandalism and supporters would not be allowed into the capital (paraphrased, AP).

name: Salman Akram Raja
quote: Said the talks deadlock stemmed from the federal demand that KP take ownership of anti-terrorism actions launched unilaterally (paraphrased, Geo).

name: Faisal Karim Kundi
quote: Said governor's rule and emergency were "final options" pending presidential and prime-ministerial approval (The News, Oct 12).
